## Understanding

<!-- STATE_BLOCK:UNDERSTANDING:BEGIN -->
<!-- MUTABLE | owner: orchestrator | populated-at: Phase 1 -->

### Requirements Summary
jira2pr currently fully supports GitHub Copilot (VS Code) by assembling a working `.github/` folder from `canonical/`. KAN-4 asks for equivalent full support for the "OpenCode" agentic CLI framework (https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode, opencode.ai), generating `AGENTS.md`, `opencode.json`, and a `.opencode/` directory tree from the same canonical source.

Acceptance criteria: `make install PLATFORM=opencode` (new Makefile target) generates and places all OpenCode artifacts into `./examples-autogenerated/opencode/`, copyable by the user into their own repo.

Explicit requirements from ticket:
- Add `--platform opencode` support to the assembler in `scripts/`.
- Generate all required OpenCode artifacts for the target repo.
- No regression to existing platforms (Copilot especially; Claude stub stays a stub).
- Only introduce `uv`-based venv if default deps (stdlib + pyyaml) are insufficient — do not touch global Python env, and do not add `uv` speculatively.
- New root `Makefile`: `make install PLATFORM=<> [TARGET_DIR=<>]` (default `./examples-autogenerated/<platform>`), plus fully documented `make help`.
- OpenCode model IDs differ from Copilot's — add an `opencode` model map to `canonical/model-tiers.yaml`.
- Update docs (`README.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`).
- **Plan approval required: YES** (ticket explicitly flags this).

### Key Constraints
- No MCP server support needed/in-scope.
- Do not modify `ClaudeAssembler`'s stub status (tracked separately under KAN-12).
- `templates.py` changes must keep Copilot output byte-identical (verified via `--check`).
- Do not touch `scripts/assemble.py` (platform choices already dynamic via `PLATFORMS.keys()`).

### Key Files and Patterns Discovered
- `scripts/assemble.py` — CLI entrypoint, `--platform` choices sourced from `assembler.platforms.PLATFORMS` (lazy registry in `scripts/assembler/platforms/__init__.py`).
- `scripts/assembler/base.py` — abstract `PlatformAssembler` (`name`, `TEMPLATE_VARS`, `assemble()`, `substitute()`).
- `scripts/assembler/registry.py` — `CanonicalRegistry`, platform-agnostic accessors (`agent_body`, `skill_body`, `skill_scripts_dir`, `instruction_body`, `prompt_body`, `state_files`, `artifacts_files`, `model_for_tier`, `platform_extras_dir`, `env_example_path`). No changes needed here.
- `scripts/assembler/writer.py` — `FileWriter` (`put`, `copy`, `copy_tree`, `check_protected_dir`, `add_warning`). Reused as-is.
- `scripts/assembler/templates.py` — `substitute_vars`, `generate_agents_section(registry, platform, project_instructions_file)`; needs a new optional `labels` param to parameterize hardcoded Copilot-specific prose so it can be reused for OpenCode's `AGENTS.md`.
- `scripts/assembler/platforms/copilot.py` (`CopilotAssembler`) — the only fully-featured assembler; mirror its method breakdown exactly for `OpenCodeAssembler`.
- `scripts/assembler/platforms/claude.py` (`ClaudeAssembler`) — deliberate stub (agents only; state/artifacts NOT implemented, tracked as KAN-12 follow-up). Not the target shape for OpenCode.
- `canonical/model-tiers.yaml` — tiers 0-3 → `models: {copilot: "..."}`; no `claude` key exists either (confirms Claude support is genuinely incomplete). Needs new `opencode:` key per tier.
- `canonical/platform-extras/copilot/README.md.tpl` + `apply_model_tiers.py` — copied/rendered by `_copy_platform_extras` / `_assemble_readme`.
- No `Makefile` currently exists at repo root.
- `README.md` root: "Available Setups" table (line ~41-43), assemble examples (line ~51, 63), and a stale "Open Code: `<project-root>/AGENTS.md` or `<project-root>/CLAUDE.md`" line (~79) that needs fixing (OpenCode only uses `AGENTS.md`).

### Build / Test / Lint Commands
- `python -m pytest tests/` — full test suite.
- `python -m pytest tests/test_assembler.py` — assembler-specific tests.
- `python scripts/assemble.py --target-dir examples-autogenerated/vscode-copilot --platform copilot --check` — regression dry-run for Copilot output.
- `python3 -m py_compile <script>` — syntax check for skill scripts.

### Open Questions
- Exact GitHub Copilot provider model-id strings for OpenCode are unconfirmed upstream — using best-effort `github-copilot/<model>` strings, flagged with a comment in `canonical/model-tiers.yaml`.

## Research Results

<!-- STATE_BLOCK:RESEARCH:BEGIN -->
<!-- MUTABLE | owner: orchestrator | populated-at: Phase 2 if researcher agent was invoked -->

### Options Evaluated
- Initial research pass (general training knowledge) incorrectly conflated "OpenCode" with an unrelated tool ("Crush" by Charmbracelet) — rejected after cross-checking against user-confirmed authoritative source.
- Second research pass fetched https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode and opencode.ai/docs directly (user-designated authoritative source) — accepted.

### Recommendation
Target OpenCode conventions confirmed from https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode / opencode.ai/docs:
- Project instructions: `AGENTS.md` at repo root.
- Config: `opencode.json` (or `.jsonc`) at repo root, `"$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json"`. Keys of interest: `model`, `small_model`, `default_agent`, `instructions` (array of paths/globs), `permission`, `mcp` (unused here).
- Custom agents: `.opencode/agent/<slug>.md` (Markdown + YAML frontmatter: `description`, `mode` [primary|subagent|all], `model` (`provider/model-id`), `permission` (map of capability → allow/ask/deny), `temperature`, `disable`, `hidden`).
- Custom commands: `.opencode/command/<slug>.md` (frontmatter: `description`, `agent`, `model`; body uses `$ARGUMENTS`).
- Skills: `.opencode/skill/<name>/SKILL.md` (frontmatter: `name` [must match dir name], `description`; optional `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`).
- Model IDs: `provider/model-id`, e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514`, `ollama/llama3.3`, `github-copilot/gpt-4.1`-style for Copilot-hosted (exact Copilot provider slug unconfirmed).
- Permission capability keys: `read`, `edit`, `bash`, `grep`, `glob`, `list`, `task`, `webfetch`, `websearch`, `todowrite`, `skill`, `lsp` — mapped from jira2pr's abstract capability tags (`read`,`edit`,`search`,`execute`,`delegate`,`plan`,`fetch`) via a new `OPENCODE_PERMISSION_MAP`.

### References
- https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode (repo file listing, `AGENTS.md` excerpt)
- https://opencode.ai/docs/ (config, agents, commands, mcp-servers, skills, models/providers)

### Tasks

| ID | Description | Status |
|----|-------------|--------|
| T1 | Parameterize `scripts/assembler/templates.py::generate_agents_section` with an optional `labels` dict (default = current Copilot strings); Copilot output must stay byte-identical | pending |
| T2 | Add `opencode:` model-id map to every tier in `canonical/model-tiers.yaml` (best-effort, flagged as unconfirmed) | pending |
| T3 | Create `canonical/platform-extras/opencode/README.md.tpl` (mirrors Copilot's, adapted for OpenCode file names/paths) | pending |
| T4 | Create `scripts/assembler/platforms/opencode.py` with `OpenCodeAssembler` — full parity with `CopilotAssembler` (agents, skills, instructions, prompts→commands, AGENTS.md, opencode.json, state, artifacts, README, platform extras, env example) | pending |
| T5 | Register `"opencode": OpenCodeAssembler` in `scripts/assembler/platforms/__init__.py` | pending |
| T6 | Create root `Makefile` with `install` (PLATFORM required, TARGET_DIR optional, validates against known platform list) and self-documenting `help` targets | pending |
| T7 | Update `README.md` (Available Setups table, Makefile usage section, fix stale "Open Code" line) | pending |
| T8 | Update `.github/copilot-instructions.md` Architecture section + Build/Test commands to mention opencode | pending |
| T9 | Add `TestOpenCodeAssembly`, opencode model-tier test, and Makefile subprocess tests to `tests/test_assembler.py` | pending |

### Test Strategy
- **Automated:** `python -m pytest tests/` (full suite, must stay green); new `TestOpenCodeAssembly` class covering agents/skills/instructions/commands/AGENTS.md/opencode.json/state/artifacts/README/env-example generation, plus an idempotency (`--check`) regression test; new `TestMakefile` class covering `make install PLATFORM=opencode` success and `make install` (missing PLATFORM) failure.
- **Manual / user validation:** Plan approval (this workflow, per ticket's "Plan approval required: YES"); after implementation, spot-check generated `examples-autogenerated/opencode/` output for structural sanity.

### Risks

| Risk | Severity | Mitigation | Status |
|------|----------|------------|--------|
| OpenCode's exact GitHub-Copilot-hosted model-id string is unconfirmed upstream | LOW | Use best-effort `github-copilot/<model>` strings with an explicit "verify before relying on" comment in `canonical/model-tiers.yaml` | open |
| `templates.py` refactor could subtly change Copilot's generated `copilot-instructions.md` output | MEDIUM | Default `labels` param preserves exact current strings; verified via `--check` dry-run + existing test suite | mitigated (pending verification in Phase 3) |
| Canonical skill/instruction bodies contain literal `.github/...` path references that will be textually inaccurate under `.opencode/` | LOW | Accepted, pre-existing limitation (mirrors unsubstituted `{{VAR}}` gaps already present for Copilot); explicitly out of scope per plan constraints | accepted |
